No per-rule resource; \texttt{akeyless\_role.rules} authoritative & all rules of a role in one place; console edits reverted & YAML merge per role; nightly drift job \\
Names are ForceNew everywhere & rename = destroy + create; auth methods get a new access ID & \texttt{prevent\_destroy}, delete protection, naming guards; CLI \texttt{update-role\ -\/-new-name} for roles \\
Temporary rules (\texttt{-\/-ttl}) CLI/API-only & removed by the next apply on that role & exporter skips them; use access requests for JIT \\
Partial \texttt{akeyless\_account\_settings}, destroy is a no-op & bound IPs, locks, client types, rotation limits, usage events not in TF & \texttt{account\_settings\_cli} + \texttt{akl\_account\_settings.py} in the apply job \\
ARA: no \texttt{ara\_reports\_access}; \texttt{ara-rule} undocumented & - & \texttt{allow\_ara\_rules} opt-in after verification \\
No write-only/ephemeral arguments & secrets in state & secret values kept out of this state; state treated as a vault \\
\texttt{akeyless\_folder} has no \texttt{type}/\texttt{accessibility} & - & item folders only \\
No RBAC users/groups & human scope = IdP claims & \texttt{force\_sub\_claims}, CODEOWNERS on role files \\
\texttt{deny} does not apply to SRA & - & use SRA capabilities \\
K8s/LDAP auth need Gateway-side config & - & out of scope (Gateway) \\
Conjur RBAC not migrated by Akeyless & - & \texttt{conjur2akeyless.py} \\
One Gateway per provider alias & - & one state/workspace per Gateway cluster \\
\end{longtable}

\hypertarget{not-verified-against-a-live-account-marked-verify}{%
\section{Not verified against a live account (marked VERIFY)}\label{not-verified-against-a-live-account-marked-verify}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  Minimum read rights of the plan identity (\texttt{bootstrap/}).
\item
  Capability needed to issue a certificate from an issuer.
\item
  \texttt{ara-rule} through the provider.
\item
  Sub-claim template syntax \texttt{\{\{x\}\}} vs \texttt{\{x\}}.
\item
  \texttt{/a/*} matching \texttt{/a} itself; operator evaluation order (simulator assumptions).
\item
  \texttt{access\_info.rules\_type} strings (exporter); exact CLI behaviour of \texttt{describe-permissions} when
  the caller has no access (verifier flag).
\item
  Item names produced by the Conjur migration.
\item
  Export: \texttt{target\_type} strings other than aws, azure, gcp, k8s and hashi\_vault (matched by name);
  the CLI command name \texttt{list-groups} (REST \texttt{/list-group}); the shape of \texttt{admins.allowed\_access}
  and the log-forwarding type in \texttt{gateway-get-config}; \texttt{/configure} and \texttt{/connect} over REST.
\end{itemize}

Everything else in this repository was checked against docs.akeyless.io, the Akeyless OpenAPI/Go
SDK and the provider source/schema, and the code is covered by offline tests.
